# Welcome

Welcome to this module PSYC7142! Very glad to have you here with us.

Rob Davies ![](https://www.lancaster.ac.uk/images/people/3324.jpg){width="1in"} and Samuel Finnerty ![](https://www.lancaster.ac.uk/images/people/13081.jpg){width="1in"} are the lecturers on this module.

We are looking forward to meeting you!

This module is designed for students who have never done data analysis or statistics before, as well as those who have background in this.

We have set up the module so that there are different exercises depending on your background.

* For those who are new to data analysis and statistics, there is a week-by-week step-by-step guide to all you need to know to become a master's-level expert in interpreting and analysing psychological data.

* For those of you who have already used our software (R-studio) for analysis before, after revising the foundations of what you need to know you can move on quickly to the extra exploratory exercises where you can hone and broaden your skills.

# Steps to get ready

Here are the steps to go through before the module begins, to help you prepare for the course:

*First:* Watch this first welcome video (part 1) from Dr. Samuel Finnerty who will introduce himself and discuss what you can expect in this module. Sam will be teaching Weeks 1 through 5. You will notice that many of the subsequent recorded lectures for weeks 1 - 5 include Prof. Padraic Monaghan who created the materials for weeks 1 - 5. Sam is teaching in place of Padraic Monaghan this year, as Padraic is on sabbatical. 

**Note:** You may see that some of the videos say PSYC401 rather than PSYC7142. These are the same content but the name changed to PSYC7142 this year.

## Help! I'm getting the error "HTTP Error 400. The size of the request headers is too long." when I try to watch a video, what do I do?
You will need to clear out the cookies and cache from your browser.
[for safari](https://support.apple.com/en-gb/guide/safari/sfri11471/16.1/mac/13.0){target="_blank"}.
[for chrome](https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/32050?hl=en&co=GENIE.Platform%3DDesktop){target="_blank"}.
[for microsoft edge](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/edge/learning-center/how-to-manage-and-clear-your-cache-and-cookies?form=MA13I2){target="_blank"}.
:::
